## Core methods and software

- Hao Y, et al. Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis. *Nature Biotechnology*. 2024.
- Hafemeister C, Satija R. Normalization and variance stabilization of single-cell RNA-seq data using regularized negative binomial regression. *Genome Biology*. 2019.
- Lun ATL, et al. EmptyDrops: distinguishing cells from empty droplets in droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing data. *Genome Biology*. 2019.
- McGinnis CS, Murrow LM, Gartner ZJ. DoubletFinder: doublet detection in single-cell RNA sequencing data using artificial nearest neighbors. *Cell Systems*. 2019.
- Germain P-L, et al. Doublet identification in single-cell sequencing data using scDblFinder. *F1000Research*. 2021.

## Documentation used by the exercises

- [Seurat reference documentation](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/)
- [Seurat `NormalizeData()` documentation](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/normalizedata)
- [Seurat `PercentageFeatureSet()` documentation](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/percentagefeatureset)
- [SCTransform documentation](https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/Seurat/)
- [scDblFinder Bioconductor documentation](https://bioconductor.org/packages/scDblFinder/)
- [Matrix package documentation](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Matrix)

Software APIs are tested by the repository smoke tests against the versions recorded in `renv.lock`.
